stories.title: Seafront wheel lease jeopardises i360, owner says
stories.summary: Sarah Willingham says she is worried about the Brighton i360's future, criticising the city council.

stories.title: Airport customers hit by payment data breach
stories.summary: Customer data is accessed after unauthorised access to a system used to process drop-off charges.

stories.title: Water resilience plans issued after supply issues

stories.title: Stage suit worn by Max Miller going to museum
stories.summary: The suit, which was owned by the Max Miller Appreciation Society, is being given to Brighton Museum.

stories.title: Samaritans closing at 'worst time', say volunteers
stories.summary: Volunteers at the Worthing branch deliver a petition to the charity's Ewell headquarters.

stories.title: Horsham's Marco Penge wins first PGA Tour title
stories.summary: England's Marco Penge completed a remarkable comeback from illness and personal struggles to win the RSM Classic in Georgia and secure his PGA Tour card for 2027.

stories.title: Frasier star Jane Leeves reflects on Sussex roots
stories.summary: Frasier actress says "I just get to be me" when she returns to East Grinstead where she grew up.

stories.title: No evidence parking site fire was arson - police
stories.summary: Sussex Police says two men arrested over the fire in Rowfant in August will face no further action.

stories.title: Brighton to host games at 2035 Women's World Cup
stories.summary: The United Kingdom will host a football World Cup for the first time since 1966.

stories.title: Newlyweds get lift from Lewes police to reception
stories.summary: Two newlyweds got a lift to their wedding reception after their vintage taxi broke down.

stories.title: Range Rover mounts Tesla in high street crash
stories.summary: Sussex Police said no arrests had been made in connection with the incident.

stories.title: South East Water reports loss after supply issues
stories.summary: South East Water records a pre-tax loss of £22.9m in the six months to 30 September.
